elements.element: Audit no more than once per 12 months
elements.evidence: "(b) be conducted more than once in any 12-month period"
"an independent public accounting firm of nationally recognized standing"
"the accounting firm shall be bound by written confidentiality obligations"
"the cost of this audit shall be borne by Harpoon"

elements.element: Cost shifts to Customer only if underpayment/variance exceeds 5%
elements.evidence: "unless the audit reveals a variance exceeding 5% from the reported amounts"

elements.element: No direct access to Customer systems
Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds 10%
elements.evidence: "borne by Harpoon, unless the audit reveals a variance exceeding 5%" (cost-shift trigger is narrower/more customer-favourable)

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present: annual cap, 30 days' written notice, business hours, independent accounting firm bound by written confidentiality, Harpoon-borne cost unless variance exceeds 5%, and no direct system access.

Minimality is slightly exceeded: "and off-site where possible" adds a location restriction the preferred position does not require; it is not needed to complete the level (the no-system-access element already covers the concern).
No unrelated terms disturbed; the audit dispute and confidentiality provisions (6.12, 6.13) remain effective and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
Residual redacted alternative trigger "or [***]" in the cost sentence remains from the original and is untouched; worth a note but not a deviation.
